label: Baseline
hypothesis: Freeze the original thresholded writer and recency-based retrieval.
predicted_effect: Useful direct facts work; entity and temporal ambiguity remain visible.

proposer.name: Codex
proposer.attribution: Authored by Codex while building this demo, with public access to all scenarios; no runtime provider call.

label: Agent proposal 1
hypothesis: Applying entity and temporal filters before ranking will remove cross-entity distractors and records outside the requested as-of interval, improving complete-scenario retrieval correctness without changing writes or hard-constraint behavior.
predicted_effect: Task success and relevant-memory precision should improve on entity-grounding, distractor-retrieval, historical-address, future-move, and history-boundary; distracting and stale retrieval should decrease. Storage and write precision should remain unchanged.

label: Agent proposal 2
hypothesis: Enabling deduplicate will reuse an identical active value confirmed at a later effective date, reducing redundant records while preserving retrieval correctness and hard-constraint behavior.
predicted_effect: Task success should remain approximately unchanged, while storage records and bytes should decrease, especially for repeated confirmations. Write precision and hard-constraint results should remain unchanged.

label: Agent proposal 3
hypothesis: Lowering min_confidence from 0.7 to 0.6 will admit the useful low-confidence fact while continuing to reject the demonstrated 0.3 and 0.4 low-confidence writes, improving complete-scenario success without changing retrieval behavior or duplication efficiency.
predicted_effect: Task success should improve on the useful-low-confidence scenario, with no expected change to entity/time retrieval, deduplication, storage for existing high-confidence cases, or hard-constraint outcomes on the supplied evidence.
